lines.text:
LT. SURGE: Hey there, kid!
Pretty shocking you made it through
the Pokémon League!\c
No doubt some Electric-type Pokémon had
a pretty big hand in that, right?\c
All right, then. How about you show me
what kind of Pokémon you’ve raised!
LT. SURGE: No need for introductions this time!\c\nTrainers like us have no need for words!\nLet’s go, kid!

LT. SURGE: Looks like there’s still a gap between
our skill levels I need to close, kid!\c
This is the first time I’ve felt like this since I
first arrived here in Kanto!
Come back tomorrow!
